title.zh: 旁路由网络回路与 DNS 劫持避坑宝典：主路由 DHCP 下发旁路由网关导致断网的根因分析
title.en: Side-Gateway Network Loop & DNS Hijacking Handbook: Diagnosing DHCP Gateway Loop Failures

cluster.zh: 路由器固件与家庭网关

description.zh: 深入攻克 OpenWrt 旁路由部署中最顽固的网络故障。详解主路由 DHCP Option 3/6 强推旁路由导致的局域网广播风暴、DNS 递归解析死锁、国内网页白屏及防火墙 SYN-flood 丢包排查。
description.en: Comprehensive technical diagnosis for persistent OpenWrt side-gateway failures. Troubleshoot DHCP Option 3/6 gateway loops, recursive DNS deadlocks, domestic website timeouts, and firewall SYN-flood packet drops.
